title: ticfac authors image/: end the vendoring from ticks cloud/sandbox
description: sandbox.pin.json says ticks authors the tree and ticfac never edits image/. Flip it: image/ is ticfac source; delete cmd/sandbox sync/verify-upstream and internal/sandboxpin (or reduce to a record of provenance), the CI sandbox verify job, and restate 5bp as superseded. Move the Go suite that runs the scripts (ticks internal/sandbox) or its essential cases into ticfac.
acceptance_criteria: [A1] image/ is edited directly in ticfac and CI no longer fetches ticks cloud/sandbox. [A2] The scripts' behaviour tests run in ticfac CI. [V] Verified by: make vet && make gate, and in cloudflare/: pnpm typecheck && pnpm exec vitest run.
